assertions.title: Timeline 10-second ETag polling pauses during active drag or resize gestures

steps.action: Open the timeline and observe baseline polling cadence
steps.expected: GET /operator/reservations/book/day fires on the 10s ETag interval
steps.observed: Two baseline polls at exactly 10.000s spacing (GET 304 + CORS OPTIONS 204 each)

steps.action: Press and hold a drag of the G10Shift bar onto the G10-T5 row 18:30 cell for 13 seconds (pointer down the whole time, spanning the 10s poll timer)
steps.expected: Polling paused; gesture not aborted or snapped back
steps.observed: Paused badge 'Live polling paused while moving' (timeline-poll-paused-badge) visible at hold start AND hold end; zero GET /book/day requests during the 13s hold (the tick due ~6.1s into the hold never fired); bar still present/active

steps.action: Release the pointer over the target cell
steps.expected: The assignment completes cleanly
steps.observed: POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/assign -> 200 (OPTIONS 204 preflight first); bar moved from the G10-T7 row to the G10-T5 row; sqlite: T7 occupancy deactivated, T5 occupancy active, reservation version 2 -> 3

steps.action: Confirm a second held drag (no-op drop back on the bar's own start cell, 12s hold) and check polling resumes plus console
steps.expected: No polls during hold; polling resumes after release; no console errors
steps.observed: Zero polls during the 12s hold (the tick due ~10s after page load did not fire); exactly one poll at release + 10.00s (resume); no mutation requests (expected for no-op drop); console errors: none

evidence.network: Run 1 HAR (foh-core/g10-timeline-ui/VAL-HOST-011-network.har): GET book/day 304 at t-13.89s/-3.89s (10.000s apart) -> 0 requests during 13.00s hold -> POST assign 200 at release -> GET book/day 200 at release+0.06s (post-mutation refresh). Run 2: 0 polls during 12.00s hold, 1 poll at release+10.00s. Timing table: foh-core/g10-timeline-ui/VAL-HOST-011-poll-timing.txt
evidence.sqlite: rsv_table_occupancies: G10-T7 1110-1185 active=0, G10-T5 1110-1185 active=1; rsv_reservations rsv_2da14207 version 2 -> 3, assignment soft, duration 75

assertions.notes: Release also auto-reflowed the overlapping soft booking G10ReflowMain off G10-T5 onto the free G10-T6 (expected engine behavior inside the same transaction; no test impact). The polling mechanism is pause-on-interaction (interval cleared while isInteractionActive), so the drop completes after the hold without polling interference.

frictions.description: agent-browser high-level `drag` command did not dispatch the HTML5 `drop` event on the timeline grid (dragstart/dragenter/dragover fired, drop never did), so no assignment committed with it.
frictions.resolution: Switched to low-level `agent-browser mouse move/down/up` sequences with many incremental moves, releasing over the target cell (choosing cell strips not covered by reservation bars where needed).

frictions.description: The agent-browser browser for the assigned session was silently relaunched between separate Execute calls (observed as repeated `launched browser` notices, likely host resource pressure from parallel validators), losing the logged-in timeline page; one VAL-HOST-011 attempt ran against about:blank before detection (blank screenshots discarded, not used as evidence).
frictions.resolution: Re-logged in as kody via /login, added --restore so cookies persist across relaunches, and ran each gesture as one self-contained script (open, readiness wait with re-open retry, viewport, scroll, measure with in-viewport preflight, drag, hold, release, checks) so no cross-call gaps existed.

frictions.description: After a fresh page load the timeline grid is horizontally scrolled to the service start, placing the 18:30 fixture bars and target cells off-viewport (bar measured at x=2378 on a 1680px viewport); low-level mouse gestures then silently do nothing because the coordinates are outside the viewport.
frictions.resolution: Set viewport 1680x1000, then centered the target cell inside the grid's scrollable ancestor (walking up to the element with scrollWidth > clientWidth and adjusting scrollLeft) before measuring coordinates; a preflight now asserts source and target are inside the viewport. Not documented in user-testing.md.

frictions.description: The pacing strip cap defaults to the sum of all table maxCovers for the day's services, so the owned fixtures could not drive a slot to the configured cap.
frictions.resolution: Created a dedicated G10-Pacing service (15:00-17:00, 2026-10-23) with its own pacing rule (maxCovers 12) and booked two parties of 6 at 15:30 to reach 12/12 covers.

frictions.description: A party-9 booking created without a table was auto-assigned to a fitting table on creation, so no unassigned booking existed to seed the Unassigned-lane drag fixture.
frictions.resolution: Explicitly unassigned it by calling assign with an empty tableIds list, producing the Unassigned-lane fixture used for the drag flow.

observations: Contract-vs-implementation naming (verified across code, DB and payloads; intent matched, names did not): contract says locked_assignment = 0/1 and rsv_reservation_tables; the implementation persists rsv_reservations.assignment ('soft'|'locked', with rsv_reservations.table_locked as the boolean mirror) and occupancy rows in rsv_table_occupancies.
Contract event name table_assigned does not exist anywhere in the codebase; the engine records table_changed / locked / unlocked / auto_reassigned rows in rsv_reservation_events.
Reflow moves are returned as {reservationId, fromTableIds, toTableIds, toCombinationId}; the contract describes {fromTables, toTables}.
summary: Tested 9 assertions (VAL-HOST-001..008, 011): 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked. All host-stand timeline behaviors work on the real operator UI against tenant-api and SQLite: grid/lane rendering, pacing strip over-cap highlight, soft vs locked assignment, unlock-and-move prompt, horizontal time shift, resize with 200/409 conflict handling, cell booking prefill (201), auto-reflow with move notices, and 10s ETag polling that pauses for the whole held drag (0 poll requests during 12-13s holds, paused badge visible, clean POST assign -> 200 on release, polls resume at release+10.00s). Frictions: agent-browser `drag` needs low-level mouse sequences for HTML5 DnD, browser session relaunches needed --restore + single-script gestures, timeline grid needed explicit scroll/viewport setup. Contract-vs-implementation naming deviations noted for the parent (assignment vs locked_assignment; rsv_table_occupancies vs rsv_reservation_tables; auto_reassigned/table_changed vs table_assigned).
